papers.title: Longitudinal Receptive-Expressive Language Profiles in Young Autistic Children
papers.translated_title: 年轻自闭症儿童接受性-表达性语言的纵向特征
papers.author: Latreche, K.
papers.summary: Abstract Background & Aims: Language development in autism is heterogeneous and strongly predicts later functioning. The balance between receptive and expressive abilities and their developmental trajectories, however, remains poorly understood. While some autistic children exhibit a relative expressive advantage (ExpAdv), others show receptive advantage (RecAdv) or a balanced profile. Prior studies report inconsistent findings and are often limited by cross-sectional designs and small samples. The present study aimed to (1) describe longitudinal trajectories of receptive and expressive language in autistic and typically developing (TD) children; (2) classify children into ExpAdv, Balanced, and RecAdv profiles across early childhood; and (3) examine the stability and transitions of these profiles over time, including associated clinical features. Methods: We analyzed 1,174 longitudinal time points from 318 autistic children and 294 time points from 108 TD children (1.2-5.8 years) from the Geneva Autism Cohort. Receptive and expressive language were assessed with the Mullen Scales of Early Learning. Receptive-expressive balance was quantified as the ratio of receptive to expressive age equivalent scores, classifying children into ExpAdv, Balanced, and RecAdv profiles using adapted cut-offs. Mixed-effects models examined developmental trajectories, and Sankey diagrams visualized profile transitions. Autism features and adaptive behavior were compared across profiles. Results: Autistic children displayed lower expressive and receptive language than TD peers, with receptive abilities exceeding expressive skills in both groups. Overall, 30-35% of autistic children were classified as ExpAdv at 18-36 months, declining to ~12% by 48-54 months, while Balanced and RecAdv profiles became more prevalent with age. ExpAdv was associated with slower verbal and non-verbal developmental gains. Stability was highest for Balanced and RecAdv profiles (50-60%), whereas ExpAdv often transitioned to Balanced. Autistic children with stable ExpAdv profiles were more often female, less likely to receive early intervention, and showed weaker adaptive communication. Conclusions: Receptive-expressive language profiles in autistic children are dynamic. ExpAdv profile is more frequent in younger autistic children, less stable, and linked to slower verbal and non-verbal development and higher autism severity. Implications: ExpAdv may represent an early marker of autism associated with slower expressive and receptive language growth. Longitudinal monitoring of receptive and expressive skills is essential, as transitions toward Balanced or RecAdv profiles are associated with improved developmental outcomes. Early intervention before age three may facilitate transitions toward Balanced or RecAdv profiles, supporting more favorable language development and long-term outcomes. Keywords: autism; early childhood; longitudinal design; expressive language; receptive language; language profile; early intervention; language gap; discrepant profiles
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景与目的：自闭症的语言发展具有异质性，并能强烈预测其日后功能。然而，接受性能力与表达性能力之间的平衡及其发展轨迹仍知之甚少。虽然一些自闭症儿童表现出相对表达优势（ExpAdv），另一些则表现出接受优势（RecAdv）或平衡型特征。既往研究报告的结果不一致，且常受横断面设计和小样本的限制。本研究旨在：（1）描述自闭症儿童和典型发育（TD）儿童接受性与表达性语言的纵向轨迹；（2）将儿童在早期划分为ExpAdv、平衡型和RecAdv特征；（3）考察这些特征随时间的稳定性和转变，包括相关的临床特征。方法：我们分析了日内瓦自闭症队列中318名自闭症儿童的1，174个纵向时间点和108名TD儿童的294个时间点（1.2-5.8岁）。接受性和表达性语言采用Mullen早期学习量表评估。接受-表达平衡以接受性与表达性年龄当量分数的比值量化，并使用调整后的截断值将儿童分为ExpAdv、平衡型和RecAdv特征。混合效应模型用于考察发展轨迹，桑基图用于可视化特征转变。比较不同特征之间的自闭症特征和适应行为。结果：自闭症儿童的表达性和接受性语言低于TD同伴，两组中接受性能力均超过表达性技能。总体而言，30-35%的自闭症儿童在18-36个月时被归类为ExpAdv，到48-54个月时降至约12%，而平衡型和RecAdv特征随年龄增长更为常见。ExpAdv与较慢的言语和非言语发展增益相关。平衡型和RecAdv特征的稳定性最高（50-60%），而ExpAdv常转变为平衡型。具有稳定ExpAdv特征的自闭症儿童更多为女性，接受早期干预的可能性较低，并表现出较弱的适应性沟通能力。结论：自闭症儿童的接受-表达语言特征是动态变化的。ExpAdv特征在年龄较小的自闭症儿童中更常见，稳定性较低，并与较慢的言语和非言语发展及较高的自闭症严重程度相关。意义：ExpAdv可能是与表达性和接受性语言增长较慢相关的自闭症早期标志物。对接受性和表达性技能的纵向监测至关重要，因为向平衡型或RecAdv特征的转变与更好的发展结局相关。三岁前的早期干预可能促进向平衡型或RecAdv特征的转变，从而支持更有利的语言发展和长期结局。关键词：自闭症；早期儿童；纵向设计；表达性语言；接受性语言；语言特征；早期干预；语言差距；差异特征

papers.title: Beyond willingness to donate: a cross-sectional online survey to understand urgent blood-donor mobilisability among digitally reachable adults in Ghana
papers.translated_title: 超越捐赠意愿：一项横断面在线调查，以了解加纳可数字化触达成年人中紧急献血者动员能力
papers.author: Shen, H.
papers.summary: Objectives To identify factors associated with anticipated engagement in urgent blood-donor mobilisation among digitally reachable adults in Ghana. Background Digital tools may facilitate contact with potential blood donors during emergencies and blood shortages, but digital reachability does not ensure engagement with urgent requests. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional online survey across Ghana's 16 regions (September 2025-January 2026), recruiting participants via Facebook advertising and snowball sampling. Factors associated with urgent blood-donor mobilisability were assessed under four criteria: future-donation willingness; willingness to install a trusted donation app; willingness to respond to a trusted urgent-request; and practical flexibility to leave current activities. Descriptive analyses and multivariable logistic regression examined prevalence and associated factors. Results Of 1,067 respondents, 577 (54.1%) met all four criteria, compared with 91.8% reporting high future-donation willingness. Trusted-app installation willingness (83.2%) and trusted-request response willingness (82.7%) exceeded practical flexibility (66.6%). High mobilisability was associated with formal health-system trust (AOR 3.95, 95% CI 2.08-7.50), digital-response readiness (AOR 2.26, 1.66-3.08), donation knowledge (AOR 1.42, 1.03-1.97) and previous donation (AOR 1.47, 1.08-2.01). Women (AOR 0.60, 0.43-0.83), those with work-schedule barriers (AOR 0.43, 0.29-0.66) and those reporting >30-minute night-time travel to the nearest healthcare facility (AOR 0.66, 0.45-0.96) had lower adjusted odds. Conclusions Digital reachability and stated donation willingness may overestimate the population pool available for emergency donation. Digital blood-donor solutions should consider verifiable health-system requests, account for digital-response readiness and current availability, and connect willing individuals with accessible collection options and transport support where needed.
papers.translated_summary: 目标 识别与加纳可数字化触达成年人中预期参与紧急献血者动员相关的因素。背景 数字工具有助于在紧急情况和血液短缺期间联系潜在献血者，但数字化可触达并不能确保其参与紧急请求。方法 我们于2025年9月至2026年1月在加纳16个地区开展了一项横断面在线调查，通过Facebook广告和滚雪球抽样招募参与者。依据四项标准评估与紧急献血者可动员性相关的因素：未来献血意愿；安装可信献血应用程序的意愿；响应可信紧急请求的意愿；以及离开当前活动的实际灵活性。描述性分析和多变量logistic回归考察了流行率及相关因素。结果 在1，067名受访者中，577人（54.1%）满足全部四项标准，而报告高未来献血意愿者占91.8%。安装可信应用程序的意愿（83.2%）和响应可信请求的意愿（82.7%）高于实际灵活性（66.6%）。高可动员性与对正规卫生系统的信任（AOR 3.95，95% CI 2.08-7.50）、数字响应准备度（AOR 2.26，1.66-3.08）、献血知识（AOR 1.42，1.03-1.97）和既往献血史（AOR 1.47，1.08-2.01）相关。女性（AOR 0.60，0.43-0.83）、存在工作日程障碍者（AOR 0.43，0.29-0.66）以及报告夜间前往最近医疗机构需超过30分钟者（AOR 0.66，0.45-0.96）调整后比值比较低。结论 数字化可触达和自我报告的献血意愿可能高估可用于紧急献血的人群池。数字化献血者解决方案应考虑可验证的卫生系统请求，纳入数字响应准备度和当前可用性，并在需要时将有意愿的个体与可及的采集选择和交通支持相连接。

papers.title: Label-free, low-cost AI ranking for systematic review screening
papers.translated_title: 无标记、低成本的人工智能排序用于系统综述筛选
papers.author: Jo, T.
papers.summary: Title and abstract screening is among the most labor-intensive steps of systematic reviews. Jev, a low-cost AI decision model, scores records against eligibility criteria without screening labels. We scored 169,982 records from 128 reviews and, after tuning on development reviews, evaluated 23 held-out reviews once and 31 Cochrane reviews post hoc. Jev outranked the best free ranker in all 23 held-out reviews (mean AUC 0.966 vs 0.831) and came within 0.011 AUC of Claude Opus 5.5 on 1999 records at about 1/700 of its list-price cost (US$0.02/1000 records). Combined with active learning, it raised work saved at 95% recall from 0.659 to 0.806. A fixed score threshold fell below 95% recall in 3 of 28 Cochrane reviews, whereas Jev ranking with statistical stopping (post hoc) reached 95% recall in all 51 reviews, reading 86-88% of records. Label-free ranking with Jev was accurate and inexpensive, but stopping safely required screening decisions.
papers.translated_summary: 标题和摘要筛选是系统综述中最耗费人力的步骤之一。Jev是一种低成本的人工智能决策模型，无需筛选标签即可根据纳入标准对记录进行评分。我们对来自128篇综述的169,982条记录进行了评分，并在开发综述上调优后，对23篇留出综述进行了一次性评估，并对31篇Cochrane综述进行了事后评估。Jev在所有23篇留出综述中排名均优于最佳免费排序器（平均AUC为0.966对0.831），并在1999条记录上以约其标价成本1/700（每1000条记录0.02美元）的代价，AUC与Claude Opus 5.5相差仅0.011。结合主动学习，它将95%召回率下的节省工作量从0.659提高到0.806。固定分数阈值在28篇Cochrane综述中有3篇低于95%召回率，而采用统计停止（事后）的Jev排序在所有51篇综述中均达到95%召回率，阅读了86-88%的记录。使用Jev进行无标签排序准确且成本低廉，但安全停止需要筛选决策。

papers.title: Adult disability and mental/psychological illness in Somaliland socioeconomic inequalities and co-occurrence in the 2020 Somaliland Health and Demographic Survey
papers.translated_title: 索马里兰成人残疾与精神/心理疾病：2020年索马里兰健康与人口调查中的社会经济不平等与共病现象
papers.author: Saed, A. A.
papers.summary: Disability is an important population-health concern, but adult-specific evidence on its distribution and socioeconomic patterning remains limited in Somaliland. This study estimated the prevalence and distribution of reported disability among adults in Somaliland and examined socioeconomic inequality, reported mental/psychological illness, and their co-occurrence. We conducted a cross-sectional secondary analysis of the 2020 Somaliland Health and Demographic Survey. The analysis included 14,579 adults aged [≥]18 years who were usual residents, had the disability module administered, and had a defined reported mental/psychological illness measure. Reported disability was defined as at least one positive response across seven disability domains: sight, hearing, speech, learning, mobility, self-care, and mental. Survey-weighted prevalence estimates and design-based comparisons were calculated. Survey-weighted logistic regression assessed associations with household wealth and other covariates. Socioeconomic inequality was assessed using a concentration index and the normalized Erreygers concentration index. Co-occurrence was evaluated by comparing observed joint prevalence with that expected under statistical independence and by survey-weighted logistic regression. The survey-weighted prevalence of any reported disability was 7.30% (95% CI 6.65-8.02). Sight was the most frequently reported domain (3.83%, 95% CI 3.19-4.59), followed by hearing (1.54%, 95% CI 1.20-1.97) and mobility (1.39%, 95% CI 1.14-1.70). Disability prevalence increased markedly with age, from 4.15% among adults aged 18-29 years to 23.96% among those aged [≥]60 years. The crude wealth pattern was non-monotonic and was not statistically detectable after adjustment for residence and region. The concentration index for reported disability was 0.0584 (SE 0.0284, p=0.0415). Reported mental/psychological illness had a weighted prevalence of 0.71% (95% CI 0.50-1.00). Both reported disability and reported mental/psychological illness occurred in 0.5032% of adults, compared with 0.05185% expected under statistical independence; the observed-to-expected ratio was 9.70 (95% CI 7.60-11.81). After adjustment for age group and sex, reported disability was strongly associated with reported mental/psychological illness (OR 42.99, 95% CI 18.45-100.18). Reported disability affected approximately one in fourteen adults in Somaliland and showed a marked age gradient and substantial geographic variation. The crude socioeconomic pattern was attenuated after adjustment for geographic context, while concentration analysis indicated modest marginal concentration toward higher wealth ranks. Reported mental/psychological illness was uncommon but co-occurred with reported disability more often than expected under independence. These findings provide an adult population baseline for Somaliland while highlighting the need to distinguish survey-reported disability from the separate mental/psychological illness construct and to interpret the findings within the limitations of cross-sectional, survey-reported measures.
papers.translated_summary: 残疾是一个重要的群体健康问题，但关于其在索马里兰成年人中的分布和社会经济模式的证据仍然有限。本研究估计了索马里兰成年人中报告残疾的患病率和分布，并考察了社会经济不平等、报告的精神/心理疾病及其共现情况。我们对2020年索马里兰健康与人口调查进行了横断面二次分析。分析纳入14,579名年龄≥18岁的成年人，这些人为常住居民，接受了残疾模块调查，并具有明确的报告精神/心理疾病测量。报告残疾定义为在七个残疾领域（视力、听力、言语、学习、行动、自我照护和心理）中至少有一项阳性应答。计算了调查加权患病率估计值和基于设计的比较。调查加权逻辑回归评估了与家庭财富及其他协变量的关联。社会经济不平等采用集中指数和标准化Erreygers集中指数进行评估。共现通过比较观察到的联合患病率与统计独立下的期望患病率，以及通过调查加权逻辑回归进行评估。任何报告残疾的调查加权患病率为7.30%（95% CI 6.65-8.02）。视力是最常报告的领域（3.83%，95% CI 3.19-4.59），其次是听力（1.54%，95% CI 1.20-1.97）和行动（1.39%，95% CI 1.14-1.70）。残疾患病率随年龄显著增加，从18-29岁成年人的4.15%增至≥60岁人群的23.96%。粗财富模式呈非单调性，且在调整居住地和地区后未能在统计学上检出。报告残疾的集中指数为0.0584（SE 0.0284，p=0.0415）。报告精神/心理疾病的加权患病率为0.71%（95% CI 0.50-1.00）。报告残疾和报告精神/心理疾病同时发生于0.5032%的成年人中，而统计独立下的期望值为0.05185%；观察值与期望值之比为9.70（95% CI 7.60-11.81）。在调整年龄组和性别后，报告残疾与报告精神/心理疾病强烈相关（OR 42.99，95% CI 18.45-100.18）。报告残疾影响索马里兰约十四分之一的成年人，并显示出明显的年龄梯度和显著的地理差异。粗社会经济模式在地理背景调整后减弱，而集中分析表明财富等级较高者略有边际集中。报告精神/心理疾病不常见，但与报告残疾的共现频率高于独立假设下的期望值。这些发现为索马里兰提供了成年人群基线，同时强调需要将调查报告的残疾与独立的精神/心理疾病构念区分开来，并在横断面、调查报告测量的局限性内解释这些发现。

papers.title: Baseline predictors of mortality in non-idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis interstitial lung disease - A retrospective cohort study at a tertiary centre in Malaysia
papers.translated_title: 非特发性肺纤维化间质性肺疾病死亡率的基线预测因素——马来西亚一家三级中心的回顾性队列研究
papers.author: Sia, L. C.
papers.summary: Background and Aims The prognosis of interstitial lung diseases (ILDs) other than idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) has not been studied as extensively as IPF. This study aimed to evaluate baseline factors associated with mortality in non-IPF ILD, including demographic characteristics, respiratory function test (RFT), comorbidities, and ILD subtypes. Methods This retrospective cohort study analysed prospectively collected data of patients with non-IPF ILD at a single tertiary centre in Malaysia (2010-2023). Patients without baseline RFT or HRCT were excluded. Survival was assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis, and mortality predictors were identified using Cox regression. Results The mean age was 60 {+/-} 15 years, with a male-to-female ratio of 1:3. Indian ethnicity constituted the largest group (n = 109, 47.6%). The mean baseline forced vital capacity (FVC) was 53.3 {+/-} 21% predicted. An FVC <50% predicted, age [≥]50 years at diagnosis, specific ILD subtypes, and ethnicity were independently associated with mortality. Compared with Malays, both Chinese (hazard ratio [HR] 9.86, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.27-76.89, p = 0.037) and Indians (HR 8.59, 95% CI 1.14-64.69, p = 0.001) were associated with a higher risk of death. Kaplan-Meier analysis demonstrated significant differences in survival across non-IPF ILD subtypes (log-rank p = 0.048), with hypersensitivity pneumonitis showing the poorest prognosis (mean survival 6.1 years). Conclusion Ethnicity emerged as an independent prognostic factor for mortality in non-IPF ILD. The underlying mechanisms remain unclear and may reflect differences in genetic variation, cultural factors, or environmental exposures. Larger prospective studies are required to validate these findings.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目的 除特发性肺纤维化（IPF）外，其他间质性肺疾病（ILD）的预后研究不如IPF广泛。本研究旨在评估与非IPF ILD死亡率相关的基线因素，包括人口学特征、呼吸功能检查（RFT）、合并症和ILD亚型。方法 本回顾性队列研究分析了马来西亚一家三级中心（2010-2023年）前瞻性收集的非IPF ILD患者数据。排除无基线RFT或HRCT的患者。采用Kaplan-Meier分析评估生存率，采用Cox回归识别死亡预测因素。结果 平均年龄为60±15岁，男女比例为1:3。印度裔构成最大群体（n=109，47.6%）。基线平均用力肺活量（FVC）为预测值的53.3±21%。FVC<50%预测值、诊断时年龄≥50岁、特定ILD亚型和族裔与死亡率独立相关。与马来人相比，华裔（风险比[HR]9.86，95%置信区间[CI]1.27-76.89，p=0.037）和印度裔（HR 8.59，95%CI 1.14-64.69，p=0.001）均与更高的死亡风险相关。Kaplan-Meier分析显示非IPF ILD各亚型间生存率存在显著差异（log-rank p=0.048），其中过敏性肺炎预后最差（平均生存期6.1年）。结论 族裔成为非IPF ILD死亡率的独立预后因素。其潜在机制尚不清楚，可能反映遗传变异、文化因素或环境暴露的差异。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来验证这些发现。

papers.title: Genetic Architecture of Plasma Amyloid and Tau Biomarkers in the Amish
papers.translated_title: 阿米什人血浆淀粉样蛋白和Tau生物标志物的遗传结构
papers.author: Wang, P.
papers.summary: Background: Plasma biomarkers offer a minimally invasive alternative for detecting Alzheimer disease (AD) pathology, yet the genetic determinants influencing their levels remain largely underexplored. Objective: To identify genetic variants associated with AD-related plasma biomarker levels in a Midwestern Amish cohort. Methods: We analyzed plasma levels of amyloid beta (A{beta}42/A{beta}40), phosphorylated tau 181 (p-tau181), and the p-tau181/A{beta}42 ratio in the Midwestern Amish. Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) were used to examine associations with common genetic variants, while genetic linkage analysis was used to assess the potential impact of rare variants. Results: GWAS found associations between plasma biomarkers and the APOE gene. Additionally, novel candidate genes were implicated, including MME for A{beta}42/A{beta}40 ratio, and VEGFC and LRRTM4 for p-tau181. Linkage analysis identified significant signals for p-tau181 on chromosome 1, potentially involving the CSF1 and AHCYL1genes. Conclusions: The novel genetic variants associated with AD pathology implicate metabolic, synaptic, neuronal, and immune pathways. The use of GWAS and linkage analysis sheds light on the genetic architecture of AD-related plasma biomarkers.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：血浆生物标志物为检测阿尔茨海默病（AD）病理提供了一种微创替代方法，但影响其水平的遗传决定因素在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。目的：在一个中西部阿米什人队列中识别与AD相关血浆生物标志物水平相关的遗传变异。方法：我们分析了中西部阿米什人血浆中淀粉样蛋白β（Aβ42/Aβ40）、磷酸化tau 181（p-tau181）以及p-tau181/Aβ42比值的水平。采用全基因组关联研究（GWAS）检验与常见遗传变异的关联，同时采用遗传连锁分析评估罕见变异的潜在影响。结果：GWAS发现了血浆生物标志物与APOE基因之间的关联。此外，还涉及新的候选基因，包括与Aβ42/Aβ40比值相关的MME，以及与p-tau181相关的VEGFC和LRRTM4。连锁分析在1号染色体上识别出p-tau181的显著信号，可能涉及CSF1和AHCYL1基因。结论：与AD病理相关的新遗传变异涉及代谢、突触、神经元和免疫通路。GWAS和连锁分析的应用揭示了AD相关血浆生物标志物的遗传架构。

papers.title: Bi-allelic UQCC1 variants impair mitochondrial complex III assembly causing early-onset mitochondrial disease
papers.translated_title: 双等位基因UQCC1变异损害线粒体复合物III组装导致早发性线粒体疾病
papers.author: Taylor, R. W.
papers.summary: Mitochondrial disease arises from variants in either the mitochondrial or nuclear genome that impair mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation. Complex III (ubiquinol:cytochrome c oxidoreductase, CIII2) is a key enzyme of the mitochondrial respiratory chain, catalyzing electron transfer from reduced coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinol) to complex IV, via cytochrome c. CIII2 has one subunit encoded by mitochondrial DNA, the remainder being nuclear encoded. Individuals with CIII2 deficiency present with significant clinical heterogeneity, on account of pathogenic variants in genes encoding structural CIII2 subunits or assembly factors. UQCC1 (GenBank: NM_018244.5) encodes the mitochondrial complex III assembly factor Ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase complex assembly factor 1, which is currently not associated with human disease. Here we describe nine subjects from eight unrelated families harboring biallelic UQCC1 variants with heterogeneous, early-onset mitochondrial disease presentations and lactic acidosis. Subject-derived fibroblasts demonstrated a decrease in the steady-state levels of UQCC1 and its interacting partner UQCC2, with structural modelling supportive of variant pathogenicity. BN-PAGE and quantitative proteomics demonstrated decreased CIII2 abundance whilst mass spectrometry (MS)-complexome profiling corroborated these findings, identifying impaired respiratory supercomplex formation and a delay in the incorporation of newly synthesized CIII2 subunits into native assemblies. Lentiviral transduction experiments in subject-derived fibroblasts restored the levels of both UQCC1 protein and CIII2 activity. Collectively, these findings provide convergent genetic, biochemical, proteomic and functional evidence that bi-allelic UQCC1 variants disrupt CIII2 assembly, establishing UQCC1 deficiency as a cause of mitochondrial CIII2 deficiency.
papers.translated_summary: 线粒体疾病源于线粒体基因组或核基因组中的变异，这些变异损害线粒体氧化磷酸化。复合体III（泛醇：细胞色素c氧化还原酶，CIII2）是线粒体呼吸链的关键酶，催化电子从还原型辅酶Q10（泛醇）经由细胞色素c向复合体IV转移。CIII2有一个亚基由线粒体DNA编码，其余均由核基因编码。CIII2缺陷个体因编码CIII2结构亚基或组装因子的基因存在致病变异而表现出显著的临床异质性。UQCC1（GenBank：NM_018244.5）编码线粒体复合体III组装因子泛醇-细胞色素c还原酶复合体组装因子1，目前尚未与人类疾病相关联。本文描述了来自八个无亲缘关系家庭的九名受试者，他们携带双等位基因UQCC1变异，表现出异质性的早发性线粒体疾病表型和乳酸酸中毒。受试者来源的成纤维细胞显示UQCC1及其相互作用伙伴UQCC2的稳态水平下降，结构建模支持变异的致病性。BN-PAGE和定量蛋白质组学显示CIII2丰度降低，质谱（MS）复合体组学分析证实了这些发现，并识别出呼吸链超复合体形成受损以及新合成的CIII2亚基掺入天然组装体的延迟。在受试者来源的成纤维细胞中进行慢病毒转导实验恢复了UQCC1蛋白水平和CIII2活性。总之，这些发现提供了遗传学、生物化学、蛋白质组学和功能学的汇聚性证据，表明双等位基因UQCC1变异破坏CIII2组装，从而确立UQCC1缺陷是线粒体CIII2缺陷的一个病因。

papers.title: Patient-Reported Shared Decision-Making and Documented Advance Care Planning Among Adults With Alzheimer Disease and Related Dementias
papers.translated_title: 阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症成人患者中患者报告的共享决策与记录的预先护理计划
papers.author: Wang, X.
papers.summary: Objective To examine the association between patient-reported shared decision-making (SDM) and documented advance care planning (ACP) among adults with Alzheimer disease and related dementias (ADRD), and to assess whether this association differed between adults with and without ADRD. Design Retrospective observational study using linked survey and electronic health record (EHR) data. Setting and Participants Participants aged [≥]50 years in the All of Us Research Program who completed a patient-reported SDM measure and had linked EHR records. The primary analytic cohort included 3,635 adults with ADRD; 123,681 adults without ADRD comprised a secondary comparison cohort. Methods SDM was measured by how often clinicians asked participants about their opinions or preferences regarding medical care or treatment and was categorized as high (always/most of the time) or low (some of the time/ None of the time). Documented ACP was identified within 3 years before or after the SDM assessment. Modified Poisson regression with robust variance estimated prevalence ratios (PRs) and adjusted PRs (aPRs). Results Among adults with ADRD, 60.6% reported high SDM. Documented ACP prevalence was 5.1% among participants with high SDM and 3.6% among those with low SDM (P=0.027). High SDM was associated with greater ACP prevalence in the unadjusted model (PR, 1.44; 95% CI, 1.04-1.99); the association remained positive but was attenuated after full adjustment (aPR, 1.28; 95% CI, 0.93-1.77). Among adults without ADRD, high SDM was associated with documented ACP (aPR, 1.17; 95% CI, 1.03-1.33). Conclusions and Implications Among adults with ADRD, high SDM was associated with greater ACP prevalence in unadjusted analyses, although the fully adjusted association was not statistically significant. In contrast, higher SDM remained significantly associated with ACP among those without ADRD. The low prevalence of ACP highlights an important opportunity to expand discussions of current and future care preferences as a routine component of patient-centered care.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 探讨阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆（ADRD）成人患者中患者报告的共享决策（SDM）与记录的预先护理计划（ACP）之间的关联，并评估该关联在患有和不患有ADRD的成人之间是否存在差异。设计 采用关联调查和电子健康记录（EHR）数据的回顾性观察性研究。地点与参与者 参与“All of Us研究计划”、年龄≥50岁、完成了患者报告的SDM测量并具有关联EHR记录的参与者。主要分析队列包括3，635名患有ADRD的成人；123，681名不患有ADRD的成人构成次要比较队列。方法 SDM通过临床医生询问参与者关于医疗护理或治疗意见或偏好的频率来衡量，并分为高（总是/大多数时候）或低（有时/从未）。记录的ACP在SDM评估前后3年内识别。采用稳健方差修正的Poisson回归估计患病率比（PR）和校正患病率比（aPR）。结果 在患有ADRD的成人中，60.6%报告高SDM。高SDM参与者的记录ACP患病率为5.1%，低SDM参与者为3.6%（P=0.027）。在未校正模型中，高SDM与更高的ACP患病率相关（PR，1.44；95% CI，1.04-1.99）；充分校正后该关联仍为正向但减弱（aPR，1.28；95% CI，0.93-1.77）。在不患有ADRD的成人中，高SDM与记录的ACP相关（aPR，1.17；95% CI，1.03-1.33）。结论与意义 在患有ADRD的成人中，高SDM在未校正分析中与更高的ACP患病率相关，尽管充分校正后的关联无统计学显著性。相比之下，在不患有ADRD的人群中，较高的SDM仍与ACP显著相关。ACP的低患病率凸显了一个重要机会，即扩大关于当前和未来护理偏好的讨论，将其作为以患者为中心的护理的常规组成部分。

papers.title: Longitudinal associations between neuropsychiatric symptoms, structural and perfusion MRI changes in older adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.translated_title: 轻度认知障碍老年人神经精神症状与结构和灌注MRI变化之间的纵向关联
papers.author: Lombardi, G.
papers.summary: Neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPS) are highly prevalent in Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), conceptualized as an intermediate clinical state between normal aging and dementia. Although neuroimaging studies have reported associations between NPS and brain alterations in MCI, longitudinal evidence on NPS and their relationship with multimodal MRI measures remains limited. We aimed to investigate (1) longitudinal changes in NPS, volumetric assessment and measurement of regional cerebral blood flow (CBF) within the medial temporal lobe (MTL); (2) associations between longitudinal changes in MRI measures and NPS; (3) whether baseline MRI measures predicted longitudinal changes in NPS. Thirty individuals with MCI aged over 65 years were recruited, of whom eighteen followed up for a mean period of 29 {+/-} 8.9 months. There were significant reductions in total grey matter and white matter volumes, together with volume loss in the bilateral hippocampus, bilateral parahippocampal gyrus and right entorhinal cortex (pFDR[≤]0.05) over the follow up period. Volume loss in the right parahippocampal gyrus was associated with increase in aggression (pFDR<0.01), and CBF increase in the right hippocampus and parahippocampal gyrus was associated with worsening in agitation (pFDR<0.01). Furthermore, lower baseline volume of the right entorhinal cortex was associated with increase in aggression, and lower baseline CBF in the right hippocampus and parahippocampal gyrus was associated with worsening of agitation (pFDR<0.05). Our findings highlight the importance of identifying NPS in individuals with MCI and the role of structural and perfusion MRI measures as promising biomarkers for monitoring disease progression and improving risk prediction of conversion to dementia.
papers.translated_summary: 神经精神症状（NPS）在轻度认知障碍（MCI）中高度普遍，MCI被概念化为正常衰老与痴呆之间的中间临床状态。尽管神经影像学研究已报道MCI中NPS与大脑改变之间的关联，但关于NPS及其与多模态MRI测量关系的纵向证据仍然有限。我们旨在研究：（1）NPS的纵向变化、体积评估以及内侧颞叶（MTL）区域脑血流量（CBF）的测量；（2）MRI测量的纵向变化与NPS之间的关联；（3）基线MRI测量是否预测NPS的纵向变化。共招募了30名年龄超过65岁的MCI个体，其中18人完成了平均29±8.9个月的随访。在随访期间，总灰质和白质体积显著减少，同时双侧海马、双侧海马旁回和右侧内嗅皮层体积丧失（pFDR≤0.05）。右侧海马旁回体积丧失与攻击性增加相关（pFDR<0.01），右侧海马和海马旁回CBF增加与激越恶化相关（pFDR<0.01）。此外，较低的基线右侧内嗅皮层体积与攻击性增加相关，较低的基线右侧海马和海马旁回CBF与激越恶化相关（pFDR<0.05）。我们的研究结果强调了识别MCI个体中NPS的重要性，以及结构性和灌注MRI测量作为监测疾病进展和改善痴呆转化风险预测的有前景生物标志物的作用。

papers.title: Cost-Effectiveness of Expanding Housing Access for People Experiencing Homelessness and Opioid Use Disorder in California
papers.translated_title: 扩大加利福尼亚州无家可归且患有阿片类药物使用障碍人群住房可及性的成本效益
papers.author: Ling, Y.
papers.summary: People experiencing homelessness (PEH) have substantially lower quality-adjusted life expectancy and substantially higher healthcare spending compared to housed populations. California has the largest population of PEH in the United States, and an estimated ten percent of PEH have co-occurring opioid use disorder (OUD). We developed a lifetime, individual-level microsimulation of the 18,928 PEH with OUD in California to evaluate the health and economic effects of expanding access to housing through a Housing First approach, which does not require OUD treatment or abstinence. Increases in permanent housing and shelter access were based on Los Angeles County's Measure A goals, and we accounted for both housing and healthcare costs. Expanding housing access increased mean age at death by 0.34 years, reduced fatal overdoses for the cohort by 39, and produced an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio of $31,083 per quality-adjusted life-year gained, well below conventional willingness-to-pay thresholds. We provide evidence that housing is a high-value health intervention for PEH with OUD in California. Policymakers should support Housing First programs as part of integrated responses to the intertwined crises of homelessness and opioid use.
papers.translated_summary: 经历无家可归者（PEH）与有住房人群相比，其质量调整预期寿命显著更低，医疗支出显著更高。加利福尼亚州拥有美国最多的PEH人口，估计有百分之十的PEH合并阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）。我们开发了一个针对加州18,928名合并OUD的PEH的终身、个体层面微观模拟模型，以评估通过“住房优先”方法扩大住房可及性的健康和经济影响，该方法不要求OUD治疗或戒断。永久性住房和庇护所可及性的增加基于洛杉矶县Measure A的目标，我们同时考虑了住房和医疗成本。扩大住房可及性使平均死亡年龄增加0.34年，使该队列的致命过量用药减少39例，并产生每获得一个质量调整生命年31,083美元的增量成本效果比，远低于常规支付意愿阈值。我们提供证据表明，住房对加州合并OUD的PEH是一种高价值健康干预。政策制定者应支持“住房优先”项目，将其作为对无家可归与阿片类药物使用交织危机综合应对的一部分。
